candidates.name: Chunked attempt recordings with persisted checkpoint
candidates.reason: Break the inputs into manageable pages, record each page's completion in a lightweight Convex checkpoint row before issuing the next page, then let `recordLlmAttemptStart` resume from the latest checkpoint instead of replaying an entire run when the 60s guard fires.
benefits: Keeps the `withPreflightGuard` segment short per page
Makes the pre-batch work resumable without inflating the global timeout
Provides a durable batch key for later observability/diagnosis

candidates.name: Increase `llm.preflightTimeoutMs` above 60s
candidates.reason: This only masks the symptoms: the command still runs a massive single fanout, so the worker will eventually time out again and the queue will still record `batch_count=0` when the guard finally fires.
